title: Memories and Experiences

story.title: Grandpa’s photo album
story.text: Last weekend, Grandpa showed me his old photo album. “Look, this is me,” he said. “I **was born** in a small village near Namangan in 1955. I **grew up** there. In my **childhood** we didn’t have a TV – we **used to** play outside all day.” | “Here I am as a **teenager**. I **started school** at seven, and I **graduated** from university in Tashkent. My parents were very **proud**.” | “We **got married** in 1980 and **moved house** to the city.” | Then he asked, “**Have you ever** flown on a plane?” “Yes, **once**,” I said. “But I **was** really **scared**!” Grandpa laughed. “I flew **for the first time** when I was forty. I was scared too!” | “Do you **miss** the village?” I asked. “Sometimes. I **remember** every street. I’ll **never** **forget** those days.” | It was an **unforgettable** afternoon. Then Grandpa asked, “Have you finished your homework **yet**?” I said, “I’ve **just** started!” I was a bit **embarrassed**.
tf: He used to play outside a lot.
Grandpa has never flown on a plane.

answers: What did you use to do when you were a child?
**When I was a child, I used to** climb trees in my grandma’s garden. **For example**, every summer I picked apples and cherries. I really **miss** those days.
Have you ever met a famous person?
**Yes, I have** – **once**! I met a famous football player at the airport. **I felt really** excited **at that moment**, and we took a photo together.
speech: Hello everyone! I want to share a special memory. **I’ll never forget the day when** I started school. I was six years old. My mum bought me a new bag and a white shirt. **I remember** I was very **scared** – I didn’t know anyone! But a girl sat next to me and gave me a sweet. Now she is my best friend. **When I was a child, I used to** cry every morning before school, but later I loved it. **Looking back, I think** that day changed my life, because I found a real friend. Thank you!
